### Considerations
- I've chosen neutral colors for most backgrounds and borders to ensure readability and contrast.
- Primary, secondary, and tertiary colors are used for highlight elements like alerts, warnings, and brand-specific style elements.
- For text and icons, higher contrast variations are chosen to ensure accessibility and readability against varied backgrounds.
